verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a phone service, so a number-provisioning API is a fair question, but the evidence shows no developer API for it. Number management happens through the app and dashboard, and porting is a manual, representative-handled process (forms, Letter of Authorization, a dedicated rep). Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec all returned 404. No documented capability to search, buy, or configure numbers programmatically was found.
